rationale: jts3 tune B with the full-boost block (ADR-0359). The threshold assumes a bridged amp board (two TPA3255 chips) on 36 V: the rear lane runs about 5 dB over the front at 30 Hz, so only near-full-scale deep bass at 100% reaches the -1 dBFS limiter. A single-ended board (one chip) starts at -21 dBFS. The 100 Hz detector is right for B because its 114 Hz cut keeps the band above cool.
